messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 2165432109 detected: sustained KV cache growth on prod-rtp-cluster-5 causing paging and latency cliffs. Auto-throttle engaged. Details: eviction_rate ↑ 8x, p95 latency ↑ 3.4x. Alerting oncall.

alice.wang: I'm on it. grabbing logs and current config. paging observed on all AWQ models behind /generate routes?

raj.patel: Confirming - hot path looks like AWQ+gptq mixed kernel selection after yesterday's runtime change. KV size sampled ~2.8x expected for some kv entries.

jordan_sre: Visibility: GPU mem pressure spikes → continuous batching windows growing (cont_batch_ms from 20→200). Workers start spilling prefixes to disk, causing io wait.

alice.wang: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) reduce cont_batch_ms to 10 on prod-rtp-cluster-5 2) tighten batch size soft-limit 3) roll back kernel selection policy for AWQ to previous stable. Which should we do first?

raj.patel: Do (1) and (2) now. (3) needs a canary because it touches kernel paths for many models. I'll prepare revert patch.

alice.wang: ok executing batch config hotfix. running command:

```
kubectl -n inference patch cm cont-batch-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/cont_batch_ms","value":10},{"op":"replace","path":"/soft_batch_token_limit","value":1024}]'
```

alice.wang: applied, rolling restart of rtps on cluster-5 (graceful).

deploy-bot: Started rolling restart for deployment/rtp-cluster-5 (3 pods at a time). ETA ~2m per pod.

jordan_sre: watching metrics. eviction_rate back down ~60% within 90s. prefix spill I/O drops noticeably. p95 latency trending down but still above baseline.

eva_cs: Customer impact check: CS flagged two customers (acme-inc, finlytics) reporting timeouts ~9:15-9:40 UTC for batch synth workloads. No permanent data loss. Logged and notifying accounts.

raj.patel: Kernel revert plan (canary): build image with previous kernel-selection heuristic, deploy to canary subset (10% gw traffic) for AWQ/gptq routes. If stable for 15m, promote. Creating PR now.

ml-ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4821 (runtime/kernel-revert). Tests: load-compare, kv-footprint-smoke.

raj.patel: canary deploy command:

```
kubectl set image deploy/rtp-canary runtime=redwood/runtime:kernel-revert-4821 --namespace=inference
kubectl annotate svc/rtp-canary routing=canary --namespace=inference
```

alice.wang: canary up. routing shows ~12% of AWQ/gptq traffic. observability dashboards: kv_entry_size median back to baseline for canary pods. No paging on canary.

jordan_sre: Good signal. For cluster-5 non-canary pods we're seeing intermittent spikes tied to a single model shard (m-shard-17). Suggest temporarily pinning that shard to lower-concurrency nodes to reduce cross-tenant spill.

raj.patel: I'm scheduling shard pinning: `shardctl pin m-shard-17 --node-class low-concurrency`. Doing now.

alice.wang: pin applied. cluster-5 p95 latency now within 1.15x baseline. eviction_rate stable. Rolling restart continues.

eva_cs: Notifying affected customers: acme-inc sees degradations cleared; finlytics reports improved ok on test harness. I'll send follow-up with timeline and RCA stub. :+1:

alice.wang: action items: 
- (raj) promote kernel revert after 15m stable canary (TRACKER-INC216543)
- (jordan) write runbook addendum for cont-batch_ms emergency knob and shard pinning procedure
- (eva) customer comms + PS follow-up for acme-inc/finlytics
- (alice) postmortem draft and model-eval to check kv-size regression surface

raj.patel: promoting kernel revert to prod across AWQ/gptq routes in waves. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/rtp --namespace=inference --timeout=10m`

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated.

jordan_sre: After promotion, observing uniform KV entry sizes drop ~2.6x across nodes. Disk spill rate back to baseline. No further paging alerts in 12m.

alice.wang: incident status -> mitigated. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes. Will move to postmortem channel when doc ready. Great coordination, team. :tada:

ml-ci-bot: Reminder: schedule regression test to reproduce kv-size blowup in CI with AWQ+GPTQ combo (test matrix entry added).
summary: Incident thread covering KV cache blowup due to quantization/kernel selection changes; live mitigations included batch config hotfix, shard pinning, and kernel revert canary -> promote. Customer impact and action items recorded.
